guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice shows the dominant anomaly: cpu rose +656% (z=+67), with latency-90 up +867% and latency-50 up +780%, while its memory moved only +14.8% and no other service has a comparable shift. The slow traces go through frontendservice -> currencyservice -> productcatalogservice and are not the recommendationservice path, and currencyservice and productcatalogservice latencies are flat, so they are likely a separate, secondary symptom. The conntrack runbook excerpt does not fit, since there is no socket-level evidence beyond a minor frontend_socket change (+8.9%).

proposed_fix.description: Investigate recommendationservice CPU saturation (inspect hot code paths or profile it), and temporarily scale out replicas or raise its CPU limits to relieve load; no data is deleted.
